methodology.car_window: +1 through +h trading days after day 0, the last session on/before the disclosure date; day 0 itself excluded
methodology.predictions: Uncalibrated heuristic percentage-point magnitudes; same magnitude at every horizon.
methodology.sector_baseline: Ex-post mean market-model CAR of fixed cached same-sector peers, excluding target. Control comparison, not a forecast.
methodology.evaluation: Per horizon and relation group: direction hit rate, MAE vs predict-zero MAE. 95% CIs from 10000 event-cluster percentile bootstrap resamples (seed 2026); two-sided exact binomial test of hit rate vs 50%, which assumes independent predictions.

limitations: Small, hand-selected historical demonstration; selection and survivorship bias.
Graph edges restricted to filed_date <= event date; graph remains a sparse subset.
Date-only alignment ignores publication time and excludes event-day reaction.
Adjusted Yahoo prices can be revised; historical replay is not a prospective record.
Magnitudes, weights and severities are assumptions, not calibrated expected returns.
Sector baseline uses realized peer returns and is not a tradable predictor.
Bootstrap intervals are unstable with few events; no investment-performance claim.
Issuer graph ignores product specificity: RTX A320neo issue also reaches Boeing.
